record.paper_title: Recent progress and open questions on the numerical index of Banach spaces
record.original_question: Let X be a Banach space such that ℓ_1 embeds into X*. Determine whether X must admit an equivalent norm with numerical index 1, i.e. whether 1 ∈ N(X).

evidence.quote: Problem 22. Let X be a Banach space such that ℓ1 ⊆ X∗. Is it true that 1 ∈ N (X)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a Banach space $X$, let $N(X)$ denote the set of values of the numerical index obtained over all equivalent norms on $X$; more precisely, define the numerical index of $X$ by
$$n(X)=\inf\{v(T):T\in L(X),\ \|T\|=1\},$$
where $v(T)=\sup\{|x^*(Tx)|:x\in X,\ x^*\in X^*,\ \|x\|=\|x^*\|=x^*(x)=1\}$ is the numerical radius of $T$, and set
$$N(X)=\{n(X,|||\cdot|||):|||\cdot|||\text{ is an equivalent norm on }X\}.$$
One says that $X$ admits an equivalent norm with numerical index $1$ iff $1\in N(X)$.

Question: Suppose $X$ is a Banach space whose dual $X^*$ contains an isomorphic copy of $\ell_1$. Must $1\in N(X)$, i.e., does $X$ admit an equivalent norm with numerical index $1$?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search returned related work on the numerical index, isomorphic renorming, and characterizations of spaces containing $\ell_1$, but no source was found that explicitly resolves whether every Banach space $X$ with $\ell_1\hookrightarrow X^*$ admits an equivalent norm with numerical index $1$. The status appears to remain unresolved based on available sources.

status_evidence.title: Numerical index of Banach spaces and duality
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the set of numerical indices attainable under renorming; describes intervals of values but does not resolve the ell_1-in-dual question.
status_evidence.claim: Related renorming results known, but specific question not resolved in the located sources.

status_evidence.title: A renorming characterization of Banach spaces containing ℓ_1(κ)
status_evidence.snippet: Provides renorming (octahedrality) characterizations of containing ℓ_1, without addressing numerical index 1.
status_evidence.claim: No direct resolution of the numerical-index question found.
